728-1202-3249-5268.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
728-1202-3249-5268.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3845-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5147-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5147-7422.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

851-4826-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4872-7757-7758-7843.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
4872-7757-7758-7843.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Elrond.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Time Warp.
Time Warp's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

261-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

628-6797-7219.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

413-586-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

One of Trade Caravan or Mirage Mirror has a currency counter on it.
You control a basic Island.
1025-2500-6658.description:
During your upkeep, Stasis, Trade Caravan and Mirage Mirror trigger.
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stasis trigger, causing you to pay {U}.
Resolve the Trade Caravan and Mirage Mirror triggers, putting a currency counter on each of them.
During an opponent's upkeep, activate either Trade Caravan or Mirage Mirror by removing two currency counters from it, untapping a basic Island.
Repeat.

38-2420-5805.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-5805.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat.

950-2872-4639.notablePrerequisites: Clever Conjurer and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
950-2872-4639.description:
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Clever Conjurer triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
Fatestitcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Repeat.

2438-4871-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1462-2232-2413-2768-2999.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 8.
You have not cast a spell using Demon of Fate's Design's ability this turn.
You control at least seven nontoken creatures.
1462-2232-2413-2768-2999.description:
Cast Day of the Dragons by paying 7 life due to Demon of Fate's Design.
When Day of the Dragons enters the battlefield, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Day of the Dragons trigger, exiling all creatures you control and creating that many 5/5 Dragon creature tokens.
When the Dragon(s) enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers that many times.
Resolve all but one Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the final Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Day of the Dragons to your hand from the battlefield.
When Day of the Dragons leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice all Dragons you control and return all cards exiled with Day of the Dragons to the battlefield.
 When the creatures that were exiled by Day of the Dragons enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Impassioned Orator trigger that many times.
Resolve all Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the number of creatures that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control eight or more nontoken creatures, this combo nets infinite life.

224-1264-1714-4782.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four untapped basic Islands.
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
"Blue" chosen with Gauntlet of Power.
224-1264-1714-4782.description:
Activate four Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Gauntlet of Power triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Parallax Tide by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Parallax Tide four times by removing four fade counters from it, exiling the four tapped Islands.
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Parallax Tide from the battlefield to your hand.
When Parallax Tide leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
When the Islands enter the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers four times, untapping Heidar, and allowing you to untap up to three other creatures you control and/or scry 1 up to three times.
Repeat from step 2.

3094-3609-4772-4993.manaNeeded: {7} each odd-numbered turn, with {5} available each even-numbered turn
3094-3609-4772-4993.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magistrate's Scepter's ability.
Resolve both Magistrate's Scepter abilities, putting four charge counters on it.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's first ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 one time.
Repeat from step 1.
